prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset: ONE freshly generated Farm Life beach splash illustration of {{character}}, an adult woman. Create a new drawing from her own approved character references.
Canvas: opaque horizontal16:9 landscape, target1672x941. Paint the complete environment edge to edge.

Input roles: Image1 is {{character}}'s own approved full-body swimsuit base, the authority for her identity, adult proportions, exact bikini, hair, ears, ornaments and tail markings. Image2 is her own approved Happy swimsuit portrait, the authority for her face and expression. Repose her naturally into this new scene. These are the only image inputs; neither is an existing beach render or edit target.

Scene and composition: A quiet sunlit summer beach below a small green valley harbour. Eye-level medium-long view of {{character}} resting in a raised-back wooden sunlounger, her whole figure visible. Place her left of center; the lounger runs diagonally from behind her left shoulder toward the lower-right foreground. Her shoulders and upper back rest against the inclined cushion. Her torso faces the viewer in a relaxed, upright supported recline. Both forearms rest naturally on the wooden armrests, fingers relaxed. Her legs rest comfortably together, knees gently bent, lower legs directed toward the lower right; both bare feet visible together at the foot of the lounger. She looks warmly toward us with her approved Happy expression. Leave clear room above both ear tips and all ornaments, and include both feet.

Setting and props: A thick soft ivory terry towel with muted coral stripes covers the lounger. A large cream-and-pale-blush canvas parasol shades the upper-left scene; its wooden pole stands behind the chair on the left. A small round wooden table at far left holds a clear glass vase of red hibiscus flowers and leaves and a tall citrus-mint lemonade with a citrus slice and straw. A woven wicker beach basket with a folded ivory/coral striped towel sits on the sand at lower left. A few small seashells lie at lower right. Clear turquoise shallows and small foamy waves fill the open right side. Across the bay are green coastal hills, cream waterfront houses, moored sailboats, a stone harbour breakwater and a small white lighthouse with a red roof toward the right. Bright blue sky and soft summer clouds. Keep the character's face the focus and her silhouette clear, with coherent sun and shade.

Identity and wardrobe: Match {{character}}'s own approved face shape, eyes, skin tone, hair colors and silhouette, horse ears, asymmetric accessory placement, tail colors and markings, and natural adult body proportions. Match her exact approved opaque bikini's construction, colors, trim, fittings and supportive fit. Use her own Happy portrait for the smile and eyes. Do not borrow another character's palette, body, ornaments or outfit. Bare feet; no added cover-up.

Tail placement — viewer-right, mostly hidden: Her one horse tail sweeps behind her body toward the RIGHT SIDE OF THE IMAGE, the sea-facing far side of the lounger. Its root and upper length are completely concealed behind her lower back, pelvis and cushion. Her body and the chair naturally occlude most of the tail. At most, show a small soft portion of its flowing length peeking beyond the far viewer-right edge of the lounger, resting behind the cushion. It is fine for the tail to be barely visible. Keep the viewer-left side beside the table and basket free of tail hair. Do not force the tail into view, expose its attachment, draw a connector across her body, or hang a large tuft from either armrest. The first visible strands pass BEHIND an occluding body/cushion edge, with no detached floating segment. The hidden origin is implied rather than drawn. Use only this character's approved tail color and markings.

Style: Finished softly shaded full-color2D anime illustration, fine warm linework, gentle painterly cel shading, delicate hair strands and restrained fabric/wood textures. Warm summer sun with soft pink parasol bounce, integrated lighting on skin, hair and clothing, credible hands, relaxed body weight and contact shadows. One character only. No text, UI, frame, watermark, collage or studio background. Output one polished new landscape candidate for owner review.
visualChecks: Recognizable own identity, adult proportions and exact approved bikini; both ears and feet in frame.
Raised-back wooden lounger, character left of center, diagonal toward lower right, supported relaxed pose.
Parasol, striped towels, flower/lemonade table, basket, shells, turquoise bay, green hills, harbour, sailboats and lighthouse.
Tail root/upper length hidden; small visible portion optional on viewer-right behind body/cushion; no floating tuft or visible connector.
